units.source_text: “阿姐这个人真可怜，以前的婚事吹了才来这儿的。”

en.t: "The poor woman. Her earlier marriage fell through, and that is why she came here."

units.source_text: 驹子把后面的话咽了回去，犹豫了半晌，望着沐浴在月光底下的梯田，

en.t: Komako swallowed the rest of what she had been about to say, hesitated for a while, and gazed at the terraced fields bathed in moonlight,

units.source_text: 然后又说，“那坡道半路上有间新盖的房子，是吧？”

en.t: then said again, "There is a newly built house halfway up that slope, isn't there?"
